[FACT] User has been using Sweet Baby Ray's BBQ sauce and loves it.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new BBQ sauce brands to try.  
[EVENT] User attended a backyard BBQ party at a colleague's house on the 3rd of June.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sweet Baby Ray's is a great choice, and the assistant is happy to help with recommendations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended BBQ sauce brands:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Franklin Barbecue Sauce: thicker, sweeter sauce with a rich texture.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Kansas City Masterpiece: offers a range of flavors, made with honey and molasses.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Stubb's BBQ Sauce: thick, syrupy consistency with sweet and tangy flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Dinosaur Bar-B-Que Sauce: sweet and tangy, similar to Sweet Baby Ray's.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Bone Suckin' Sauce: sweet and smoky, good for pork, beef, or chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Gates BBQ Sauce: thick and sweet, similar flavor profile to Sweet Baby Ray's.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to know the difference between Kansas City Masterpiece and Gates BBQ Sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Similarities between Kansas City Masterpiece and Gates BBQ Sauce: both are thick, sweet, tomato-based sauces popular in Kansas City BBQ.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Differences:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Kansas City Masterpiece was founded in 1977; Gates BBQ Sauce in 1946.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Kansas City Masterpiece has a complex ingredient list; Gates BBQ Sauce has a simpler one.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Kansas City Masterpiece has a robust flavor profile; Gates BBQ Sauce is sweeter and milder.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Kansas City Masterpiece is thicker and more syrupy; Gates BBQ Sauce is slightly more pourable.  
[PREFERENCE] User decides to try Kansas City Masterpiece BBQ sauce.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been experimenting with different BBQ recipes at home.  
[EVENT] User tried apple wood chips last weekend and enjoyed the fruity flavor they added to grilled chicken.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of trying hickory wood chips next.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for using hickory wood chips effectively:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Start with a small amount (about 1/2 cup).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Soak the chips for at least 30 minutes.
